title: The Mist Glade
author: Gamebook Player sample
rights: Original sample text written for this repository. It is not a published gamebook, and this repository has no chosen license for it.

body: Mist hangs over a quiet glade where a stream bends around a fallen oak. A ring of pale blue mushrooms grows at the water's edge. They smell of honey, but you cannot recall whether they are safe to eat.
The stream narrows between mossy stones and the mist thins. Somewhere ahead, a bell rings once.
You remember a gardener's warning: blue caps that smell of honey are harmless, and the ring around them marks clean water. You drink, and feel rested.
The mushroom tastes of nothing at all. For a moment the mist glows, then your head swims.
From the top of the oak you can see a grey roof beyond the trees, and smoke rising from it.
You leave the glade by a deer path. The mist closes behind you.
